text:
In March, we learned that Varnholt Logistics appointed Ilse Marrenkamp as chief executive, effective immediately. The move followed a six-month review of the company’s freight-routing software and depot scheduling, which Marrenkamp had overseen as interim operations director.

- Appointment date: 14 March
- New role: chief executive, Varnholt Logistics
- Previous post: interim operations director
- Head office: Keldermark
- Reported priorities: fleet uptime, warehouse scan accuracy, and cross-dock throughput
- First announced initiative: a 12-week review of route-planning delays at three regional hubs

We also noted that the board cited her record on reducing empty-mile runs by 11% last year. A further management update is expected before the end of the quarter.
